description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Palazzo Unit 301” – a serene Gulf front condo in Panama City Beach. This stunning vacation rental offers breathtaking floor-to-ceiling ocean views, that many consider the finest in 30A, 3 en-suite bedrooms, and seasonal beach chair setups. Located steps from the beach and 1 mile from Pier Park, enjoy access to a Gulf-front pool, hot tub, and fitness center. Discover relaxation at its finest. Learn more below… *** HIGHLIGHTS ***Unparalleled Gulf Views from Floor to Ceiling Windows and a Private BalconySteps to Private Beach AccessCommunity Pool, Hot Tub & Fitness CenterSpacious and Private: Perfect for families or couples traveling together3 En-Suite Bedrooms with Luxurious AmenitiesConvenient Amenities: Covered parking, and a well-stocked kitchenSeasonal Beach Chair Setup (March–October) IncludedEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Best view in Panama with panoramic views. Couldn't get much better. Layout of condo allowed for privacy of 3 couples without being on top of each other." – Jennifer⭐"The listing photos looked great, but it was even better in person. This is the best stocked kitchen I've had at a unit at the Palazzo, with everything to comfortably cook all week." – Amanda M.⭐"Beautiful condo! Everything was just as it was described! Easy access to beach and the free umbrella and chairs were such a nice treat!" – Lance W.*** LIVING AREA ***Start your day with breathtaking Gulf views from the living and dining areas of this expansive retreat. The open-concept layout is designed for comfort, offering an inviting space to relax and connect with loved ones. Unwind on the plush seating while enjoying your favorite shows on the large flat-screen TV, or step through the sliding glass doors onto the balcony to savor the soothing sound of crashing waves.Cozy living room with awe-inspiring Gulf views and premium seatingFlat-screen TV for entertainmentDirect balcony access*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Channel your inner chef in a fully equipped kitchen, featuring modern appliances and ample prep space. Serve homemade meals in the adjoining dining area or take them to the balcony to enjoy scenic sunsets with every bite.Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliancesDining table seating 6Breakfast bar perfect for quick bites*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***The Palazzo Condominiums offer high-end amenities you'll love. Take a dip in the elevated Gulf-front pool, relax in the hot tub, or break a sweat in the fitness center—all while staying just steps from the beach.Gulf-front pool and hot tubFitness CenterCovered parking with easy building access*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Relax and recharge in 3 en-suite bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed for comfort and privacy. Plus, there’s a queen sleeper sofa in the living room to accommodate extra guests. Gulf-Front, Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tubKing Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen Bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with singel vanity and shower/tub comboAdditonal Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeper sofa in the living room*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Ideally located in Panama City Beach, Palazzo Unit 301 is minutes away from Pier Park’s vibrant shops and restaurants and just 4 miles from Rosemary Beach. Explore local favorites like Thomas Donuts, Mike’s Cafe, or enjoy a day on the town with entertainment and live music venues nearby.Pier Park – 1 mileThomas Donuts – 3 milesRosemary Beach – 4 miles*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.HOA Requires a 3-night stay minimum year-round.Beach Chair Set Up: Two chairs and one umbrella included in rental, seasonally (March-October).*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 64410STRO #: 49300
